uncited: **Feature Extraction:** Process the global RNR-Map $m$ through convolutional network $F_k$ to obtain $m'_k$.
**Orientation Rotation:** Generate $R$ rotated versions of the query feature map $m'_q$.
Choose this variant when explicit 2D-3D geometric correspondence is preferred over latent-code cross-correlation, particularly in AR reconstruction pipelines.
If the RNR-Map is poorly constructed or lacks visual information, localization accuracy degrades.
